one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never produced the required /app/solution.txt (only solution.npy), and also regressed from a valid SLSQP solution by overwriting it with an invalid L-BFGS-B result that violated the sum constraint, before recovering a valid solution but still never saving it to the correct path.
t_err_evidence: Step 2 writes optimize.py saving the result with np.save('solution.npy', result.x) instead of np.savetxt('/app/solution.txt', result.x); the agent never reads any spec document to check the required output path.
t_commit_evidence: The wrong output path is baked into every script variant (optimize.py, optimize_v2.py, optimize_v3.py) and the final step 18 summary still references 'solution.npy'; the agent never writes /app/solution.txt in any of the 18 steps.
trigger_explanation: The agent jumped directly into writing an optimization script without reading any task specification file or evaluator contract. It assumed the standard numpy save format (solution.npy) without checking that the task requires a text file at /app/solution.txt loadable by np.loadtxt.
